gloss: immediately before; just before; right before

definitions.gloss: immediately before; just before; right before
definitions.explanation: At the very last moment before something happens. Emphasizes how close in time something is to a reference event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}に⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A phone call came right before departure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}に⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}した→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: I fell ill just before the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}に⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The materials finally arrived just before the deadline.

notes:
Composed of {直|ちょく} (direct, immediately) and ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (before) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial particle). Often used without ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ when modifying a noun directly: ⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ (last-minute preparations). The ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ form functions as a pre-noun modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}に: right before departure
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}に: just before the deadline
- {直前|ちょくぜん}に⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧: at the last moment
- ⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until the very last moment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寸前|すんぜん}→寸前：12356_sunzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the verge of — emphasizes extreme closeness, often to danger or crisis
- ⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: immediately after — the temporal opposite
- ⟦ぎりぎり→ぎりぎり：05166_girigiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the last possible moment — more colloquial, emphasizes barely making it
